ValidationRule.description: Does not allow NAS General Support Case Record types to be in NAS Account Closures queue
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(OR($RecordType.Name = "CLAS - RM",$RecordType.Name = "CLAS - Shred",$RecordType.Name = "CLAS – Data Management", $RecordType.Name = "Global Service Case")),Owner:Queue.Name = "NAS Account Closures")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Must change case to CLAS record type before adding to the NAS Account Closures Queue
